QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_34

question.text: For a Category I or II AIF, the Investment Manager or Fund Sponsor is required to maintain a continuing interest of NOT LESS than:

answer.text: 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is LOWER.
5% of corpus or INR 10 crore, whichever is LOWER (this is the Cat III rule).
No continuing-interest requirement for Cat I/II.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 12 (CTR Table 12.1) and Regulation 10: 'Investment Manager or Fund Sponsor should have a continuing interest of not less than 5 percent of the corpus or INR 10 crore, whichever is LOWER, in a Category III AIF (2.5% and INR 5 CRORE respectively for Categories I and II).' Cat I/II is 2.5% or INR 5 cr whichever is lower. The Trap: Option B is the Cat III rule — classic swap. 10% is invented. 'No requirement' is false. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests both cat numbers. On XIX-D (Cat I/II Manager), the correct Cat I/II number (2.5% / 5 cr) is the only valid answer — Cat III (5% / 10 cr) is Cross-Exam Context only.
